body:

for Hacking - Killaura 
on April 3, 2016 2:48:15 PM GMT

Explanation:
I was playing on CTH someone accused me for using killaura. Next game he was on my team and I swung my sword at him for fun so he thinks he is right. I played about ten more minutes and now I'm banned for using killaura which is definitly wrong.
I don't deserve to be banned.

Kind regards,
xApfel

replies.body:
Thanks for replying,
I can 100% guarantee you that I wasn't using hacks.
All you see in this clip is me pvping against people with 0.3 kd.
Seeing as I am into pvping since 3.5 years its not a problem for me to combo these people.
This isn't evidence at all.
I even miss some hits.
As I already said I'm swinging at my teammate for fun which was kind of stupid as someone thought I really could be hacking,
My head isn't twitching at all which with killaura would be the case especially when  changing targets. Please look at the evidence again and still think that comboing these player can't be legit.

Thanks for helping me getting unbanned.
